blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Existing world models can generate action-conditioned video from a single image. Many focus on camera movement, allowing users to explore the generated scene. However, navigation alone does not ensure that an action follows persistent rules when its outcome depends on state that is invisible in the current frame. We present Stateful Harness, a framework that separates world evolution from video rendering to support stateful and rule-governed interaction. It maintains an evolving world state under specified rules, renders each resulting event with a frozen video model, and uses the generated clip to update the world state for the next turn. At each turn, the harness resolves the action selected by the user and compiles the resulting event into an instruction, while a preview clip from an editable 3D scene provides spatial and camera guidance. To evaluate rule compliance, we build WorldState-Bench, a benchmark of 50 counterfactual twin pairs that share an initial frame and action but differ in hidden state and required outcome. Under rule-only prompting, the best of the 11 evaluated video backends produces the required endings for both cases in 32% of pairs. For MiniMax-H3, specifying the required endings raises this rate from 32% to 64%, while the full harness reaches 92% with the same frozen model. These results support separating rule execution from video rendering for world interactions with hidden state.
blocks.zh: 现有的世界模型可以从一个单一的图像中生成具有行动条件的视频. 许多人关注相机移动,让用户探索所生成的场景. 然而,如果一项行动的结果取决于当前框架中看不见的状态,单靠导航并不能确保它遵循持续的规则。 将世界进化与视频渲染分开, 它根据特定规则维持一个不断演变的世界状态,使每个由此而来的事件都使用被冻结的视频模型,并利用所生成的剪辑来更新世界状态以进行下个转弯. 在每转弯时,被拉带会解决用户所选择的动作,并将所得出的事件编译为指令,而可编辑的3D场景的预览片段则提供空间和相机指导. 为了评价遵守规则的情况,我们建立了世界邦-奔驰,这是50个反事实双对的基准,它们共享一个初始框架和行动,但在隐藏状态和所需结果方面却有所不同。 在"只规则"的提示下,11个被评价的视频后端中最优秀的在32%的对子中为两种情况产生所需的结局. 对于"MiniMax-H3",具体说明需要的收尾将这个收尾率从32%提高到了64%,而用同一种被冷冻的型号,全吊带达到92%. 这些结果支持将规则执行与视频渲染分开,用于与隐藏状态的世界互动.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Video generation has advanced rapidly, with recent models producing visually realistic videos with coherent motion ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) .
Building on this progress, interactive video world models condition generation on navigation signals, allowing users to move through and explore generated environments ( Parker-Holder and Fruchter, 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
视频的生成迅速发展,最近的一些模型制作了具有连贯运动的视觉现实视频(Wan等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年)。
在这个进展的基础上,交互式视频世界模型在导航信号上设定生成条件,让用户通过并探索生成的环境(Parker-Holder and Fruchter,2025;Wang等人,2026).

blocks.en:
Navigation control makes a generated scene explorable, but does not determine the consequences of interacting with it ( Parker-Holder and Fruchter, 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) .
Some video world models support richer interactions by conditioning generation on player or agent actions ( Valevski et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2026a ) .
However, a responsive video does not by itself ensure that an action has the outcome required by the world state and rules, or that its consequences persist across later interactions ( Ding et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026a ) .
For example, the same action should open a locked chest only when the player holds a key, even if the initial views are identical (Figure 2 ).
Such distinctions require semantic state to record variables such as inventory and progress, together with an addressable spatial state to preserve scene layout and camera paths across turns.
While prior systems incorporate explicit state through programmable engines, learned game variables, or reconstructed NPC state ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Deng et al., 2026 ) , their evaluations focus on selected mechanics and do not establish whether a frozen video model can render outcomes prescribed by newly specified rules involving hidden state.
Explicit state alone does not ensure that the consequence required by its rules appears in the generated video.
The central challenge is therefore to make state transitions authoritative and render their consequences faithfully.
blocks.zh:
导航控制使生成的场景可以探索,但无法确定与之互动的后果(Parker-Holder and Fruchter,2025;Wang et al.,2026).
一些视频世界模型通过在玩家或代理动作上调节生成支持更丰富的互动(Valevski等人,2025年;Zhu等人,2026a ).
然而,一个反应灵敏的视频本身并不能确保某项行动具有世界状态和规则所要求的结果,也无法确保它的后果在以后的相互作用中持续存在(Ding等人,2026年;徐等人,2026年a).
例如,同一动作只有在玩家持有密钥时才会打开一个锁定的胸膛,即使初始视图相同(图2).
这种区分需要语义状态来记录目录和进展等变量,以及可地址的空间状态来保存场景布局和跨转弯的相机路径.
虽然先前的系统通过可编程引擎,博学的游戏变量,或重建NPC状态(黄等人,2026年;林等人,2026年;邓等人,2026年)来包含明确状态,但其评价侧重于选定的力学,并不确定一个冷冻的视频模型是否能够使新指定的规则所规定的结果涉及隐藏状态.
仅凭明确状态并不能确保其规则所要求的后果出现在生成的视频中。
因此,主要的挑战是使国家过渡具有权威性并忠实地产生其后果。

blocks.en:
We present Stateful Harness , a framework that separates world evolution from video rendering to support stateful interaction under specified rules (Figure 1 ).
It maintains an evolving world state under specified rules, renders each resulting event with a frozen video model, and uses the generated clip to update the world state for the next turn.
Given a world description and an initial image, a coding agent defines the world state, available actions, and executable rules, while an editable 3D scene represents the spatial layout.
The rules remain fixed as the world state evolves through user actions.
At each turn, the user observes the current scene and selects an action, which the runtime resolves against the current state before rendering.
The resolved event is compiled into a VisualScript instruction, and a preview clip from the updated 3D scene provides spatial and camera guidance.
A frozen video model renders the event from these inputs and a visual anchor drawn from the initial image or preceding clip.
A vision language model then interprets the generated clip and proposes updates to the semantic and spatial state based on the observed events.
The runtime incorporates updates compatible with the fixed rules, and the resulting state determines the consequences of subsequent actions.
Together, rule execution, video generation, and visual observation form a closed loop that yields state world models .

blocks.en:
To evaluate whether an action yields a visible event consistent with hidden state, we construct WorldState-Bench with a Change-to-Comply protocol.
Change assesses whether the action produces a discernible event, and Comply assesses whether that event satisfies an executable rule.
Each of the 50 cases comprises a counterfactual pair with the same initial frame, action, and rule program but different hidden values that require distinct outcomes.
We introduce PairFollow and PairStrict as two metrics for joint evaluation of each counterfactual pair. PairFollow requires both clips to show their required endings, whereas PairStrict additionally requires the forbidden ending to be absent from both clips.
Among eleven unwrapped video backends, the highest PairFollow score under the Rule-only condition is 32%.
For MiniMax-H3, explicitly specifying the required ending increases PairFollow from 32% to 64%, although PairStrict reaches only 4%.
With MiniMax-H3, the complete Stateful Harness framework achieves 92% PairFollow and 90% PairStrict on the same cases.
Beyond the single-turn probe, the same closed loop carries state across longer episodes, as in the multi-turn duel of Figure 6 , and extends training-free to worlds whose custom rules and state are written as a new world definition.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
World Models. World models study action-conditioned predictions ( Micheli et al., 2022 ; Hafner et al., 2025 ; Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ) .
The Genie series introduces latent actions and promptable environments ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; Parker-Holder et al., 2024 ; Parker-Holder and Fruchter, 2025 ) , while Oasis demonstrates interaction in an open world ( Decart and Etched, 2024 ) .
Other systems expand scene range, streaming, and instruction following ( He et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Robbyant Team et al., 2026 ; Yin et al., 2026 ; DreamX Team et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ) , separate appearance from actions ( Yu et al., 2025b ) , use game corpora ( Che et al., 2025 ; Kanervisto et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2024a ; Tang et al., 2025 ) , or address memory and visual consistency ( Xiao et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2025b ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Garcin et al., 2026 ) .
Building on action-conditioned rendering, Stateful Harness uses executable rules to resolve each action against explicit semantic and spatial state before a frozen video model renders the resulting event.

blocks.en:
Explicit State and Rules. Rules can be searched as generative objects or compiled from language ( Salen and Zimmerman, 2003 ; Cook et al., 2013 ; Hsu et al., 2026 ) .
PWM couples an engine and a 3D oriented-box representation with conditioning at the pixel level ( Huang et al., 2026 ) .
Code World Model compiles a code-maintained state into proxy video and fine-tunes its renderer ( Chen et al., 2026b ) .
Other work generates rule code without a video renderer ( Lehrach et al., 2026 ) , recovers state from generated frames ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , or conditions generation on selected state variables ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Meng et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026a ) .
Narrative and character state can also be generated together ( Li et al., 2025a ; Cheng et al., 2025 ) .
We combine a persistent editable scene, a semantic state ledger, and the standard reference inputs of a frozen renderer.
This combination is minimal: new rule-governed worlds reduce to a small typed program, no engine or fine-tuning.

World Modeling Evaluation. Most existing benchmarks measure visual quality, prompt adherence, navigation, subject actions, event editing, and perspective changes ( Ying et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026b ; Xu et al., 2026a ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Ding et al., 2026 ; Fang et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) .
Camera and geometry states can be tracked or remembered ( Nam et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2025b ) .
These measurements are valuable for navigability and continuity, but they do not directly test whether identical images and actions produce different rule-mandated outcomes when only hidden state changes.
Concurrent work tests whether a shell-game arrangement is retained in the model’s internal state across a swap chain ( Shin et al., 2026 ) . WorldState-Bench instead keeps the hidden state in an explicit rule program and tests whether the mandated outcome is executed in rendered video.
Benchmarks inside executable games can compare behavior with engine state ( Hafner, 2022 ; Bard et al., 2020 ; Light et al., 2023 ; Ouyang et al., 2026 ; La et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ) , but require an existing game or simulator.
WorldState-Bench supplies an explicit rule program and tests its consequences in generated video.

同时期的工作测试模型的内部状态是否保留了跨越互换链的壳游戏安排(Shin等人,2026年). 世界 相反,State-Bench将隐藏状态保留在一个明确的规则程序中,并测试授权结果是否在渲染视频中执行.
可执行游戏内部的基准可以比较行为与引擎状态(Hafner, 2022;Bard等人, 2020;Light等人, 2023;Ouyang等人, 2026;La等人, 2026;Luo等人, 2026),但需要已有的游戏或模拟器.

blocks.en: 3 Method: The Stateful Harness
blocks.zh: 3个 方法 : 国策

blocks.en:
Framework Overview. A video model can depict an interaction, but a generated clip alone does not specify which changes should persist or whether those changes satisfy the rules of the world.
Figure 2 shows how identical frames and actions require different outcomes when the hidden state differs.
Inspired by the role of LLM harnesses, we place a stateful runtime around a frozen video model to separate rule execution, visual realization, and observation of the generated result.

框架概览。 视频模型可以描绘一种互动,但仅一个生成的剪辑并不能说明哪些变化应该持续,或者这些变化是否符合世界规则.
图2显示当隐藏状态不同时,相同的框架和行动需要不同的结果.
受LLM拉带作用的启发,我们把一个状态的运行时间围绕一个冷冻的视频模型,以区分规则执行,视觉实现,以及观察生成的结果.

blocks.en:
Given a world description and an initial image, a coding agent constructs an executable game definition containing the state schema, available actions, rules, events, goals, and visual semantics.
The harness initializes a semantic ledger and an editable 3D scene, while the game definition remains fixed throughout the episode.
At each turn, the user observes the current scene and selects an action, which the runtime resolves against the current state and rules to determine the event and provisional state.
The resolved event is compiled into a VisualScript instruction, and a preview clip from the updated 3D scene provides spatial and camera guidance.
A frozen video model generates the next clip from these inputs and a visual anchor drawn from the initial image or preceding clip.
A vision language model then interprets the generated events and proposes updates to the semantic and spatial state.
The runtime checks these proposals against the fixed rules and incorporates compatible updates into the world state used to resolve the next action.
The final frame also becomes the visual anchor for the next generation step.
Together, rule execution, video generation, and visual observation form a closed loop that couples explicit world state with a frozen video model, yielding a state world model .
Figure 3 illustrates world construction and the rule to render path.

We represent the evolving world state as s t = ( z t , u t ) ∈ 𝒮 sem × 𝒮 sp s_{t}=(z_{t},u_{t})\in\mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{sem}}\times\mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{sp}} .
The semantic component z t z_{t} records resources, entity attributes, progress, attitudes, and terminal status that may be invisible in the current frame.
The spatial component u t u_{t} records an editable entity layout, scale, and camera path.
A fixed rule program R R determines which events an action permits and which state changes those events require.
The harness updates the world state through a closed loop, s t + 1 = ℋ R ​ ( s t , a t , o t + 1 ) . s_{t+1}=\mathcal{H}_{R}(s_{t},\,a_{t},\,o_{t+1}). (1) Here o t + 1 o_{t+1} denotes observations extracted by a vision language model from the generated clip, and ℋ R \mathcal{H}_{R} combines rule execution with compatible updates derived from these observations.
The next state therefore incorporates both the consequences of the action and feedback from the generated video under the fixed rules R R .
The visual anchor f t f_{t} is initialized from the supplied image and subsequently updated from the final frame of each clip.

blocks.en: 3.1 Stage 0: World Construction

blocks.en:
World construction produces an executable game definition, an initial frame, a semantic ledger, and an editable spatial scene.
The game definition fixes the rules for an episode, whereas the ledger and scene change as interactions unfold.

blocks.en:
Executable Rules. From the world description, a coding agent writes the game definition in a small typed language.
Each rule has a guard that reads the current state and action, and an effect that specifies ledger updates, spatial edits, and an event.
Goal conditions inspect the ledger to determine whether an episode has ended.
The agent validates and freezes the definition before interaction begins.
In the counterfactual benchmark, both members of a pair share this definition.

This order gives fixed rules authority over action consequences while allowing generated events to inform the evolving world state.

blocks.en: 4 Benchmark: WorldState-Bench
blocks.zh: 4 基准: 世界国家-奔驰

blocks.en:
Overview. Existing benchmarks evaluate visual quality, prompt adherence, navigation, subject actions, event editing, and camera or geometric consistency ( Ying et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026b ; Xu et al., 2026a ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Ding et al., 2026 ; Fang et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Nam et al., 2026 ) .
These evaluations do not directly isolate whether a change in hidden state produces the distinct visible consequence prescribed by an executable rule.
Benchmarks based on executable games assess behavior conditioned on state provided by existing engines ( Hafner, 2022 ; Bard et al., 2020 ; Light et al., 2023 ; Ouyang et al., 2026 ; La et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ) .
Worlds initialized from a description and an image lack this predefined engine state.
To evaluate such worlds, WorldState-Bench uses counterfactual pairs with identical visible inputs, different hidden values, and expected outcomes determined by an executable rule before generation.
Joint evaluation of each pair tests whether both required outcomes are rendered correctly under the corresponding hidden states.
blocks.zh:
概览. 现有基准评价视觉质量、迅速遵守、导航、主题行动、事件编辑和相机或几何一致性(Ying等人,2026年;徐等人,2026年b;徐等人,2026年a); Zhao等人,2026年;Ding等人,2026年;Fang等人,2026年;Yang等人,2026年;Nam等人,2026年).
这些评价并不直接孤立隐藏状态的变化是否产生可执行规则规定的明显可见的后果。
基于可执行游戏的基准评估以现有引擎提供的状态为条件的行为(Hafner,2022;Bard等人,2020;Light等人,2023;Ouyang等人,2026;La等人,2026;Loo等人,2026).
从描述和图像中初始化的世界缺乏这种预定义的引擎状态.
为了评价这种世界,World State-Bench采用了具有相同可见输入,不同隐藏值的反事实对,以及由一代前可执行规则确定的预期结果.
联合评价每对测试是否在相应的隐蔽状态下正确得出所要求的结果。

blocks.en:
We formalize this with the Change-to-Comply protocol. Change assesses whether an action produces a discernible event beyond camera motion. Comply assesses whether the event satisfies the rule for the specified hidden state.
This separates the absence of an event from the generation of an event that contradicts the rule.
The primary metrics quantify Comply, while clips with no discernible event or unjudgeable content are recorded as Unclear and receive no credit.

这把没有事件与产生违背规则的事件区分开来.
主要的衡量尺度是量化的,没有明显事件或无法判断内容的剪辑记录为unclear,没有得到任何信用。

blocks.en:
Counterfactual Hidden-State Pairs. Each case contains two counterfactual instances, A and B, that share the same first frame and action script.
They differ in one hidden value z A ≠ z B z_{A}\neq z_{B} that is not observable in the shared frame.
The same rule program requires different visible endings for the two instances.
A correct ending in an isolated clip does not establish sensitivity to hidden state, whereas identical endings across a pair necessarily violate the required outcome for at least one instance.
We therefore count a pair as compliant only when both clips show their required endings.
A stricter criterion additionally requires the forbidden ending to be absent throughout both clips.

Case Construction. The benchmark comprises 50 cases drawn from 49 hidden variables and 21 scenario themes.
Hidden values select which object, character, or elemental form carries the effect.
Each hidden variable must be unobservable in the first frame and must select rule branches with visibly different outcomes.
FLUX.2 ( Black Forest Labs, 2025 ) generates the shared first frame at 1280 × 720 1280{\times}720 , and each frame is audited for visual cues that reveal the hidden value.
This audit forms part of benchmark construction.
Authors specify each case program in a typed language that determines the initial states, required endings, and fixed choice judging questions.
The harness executes the same rules used to derive the expected outcomes, so the evaluation measures whether the generated videos depict these outcomes.

每个隐藏变量必须在第一个框架中是不可观察的,必须选择具有明显不同结果的规则分支.

这项审计是基准建设的一部分。
作者用一个键入语言指定每个大小写程序,该语言决定初始状态,需要的结局,以及固定的选择判断问题.
利用手段执行同样的规则来得出预期的结果,因此评价衡量生成的视频是否描绘了这些结果.

blocks.en:
We compile two instruction conditions from each case specification. Rule-only provides the original case instruction, hidden value, selected rule branch, and action. Rule+end additionally specifies the required terminal outcome in an explicit final state sentence.
Table 1 reports results under these conditions, while the harness uses the VisualScript instruction described in § 3.2 .

表1报告在这些条件下的结果,而控制装置使用第3.2节所述的视觉脚本指示。

blocks.en:
Judging. We use the multimodal Qwen3.8-27B-VL ( Yang and others, 2025 ) to answer fixed choice questions from sampled video frames.
The questions identify the ending shown and determine whether the forbidden outcome appears at any point in the clip.
At the clip level, EndFollow requires the prescribed ending, CntAbsent requires the absence of the forbidden outcome, and Strict requires both conditions.
At the pair level, PairFollow and PairStrict require both clips to satisfy EndFollow and Strict , respectively. TwinContrast records whether the judged endings differ between the two clips.
The judge receives the expected outcomes for the relevant rule branch, but neither the hidden variable nor the rule text.
blocks.zh:
评曰. 我们使用多模式的Qune3.8-27B-VL(Yang等人,2025年)从抽样的视频帧中解答固定的选择问题.
问题确定所显示的结局,并确定所禁止的结果是否出现在剪辑的任何时候。
在剪辑层面,EndFaflow要求指定结局,CntAbsent要求没有禁止的结果,严格要求两个条件.
在对称级别,PairFollow和PairStrict分别要求两个片段满足EndFaflow和严格. TwinContrast记录了两个片段之间判断的结局是否不同.
法官收到相关规则分支的预期结果,但既非隐藏变量,也非规则文本.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experiment Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
The rule compliance experiments use the 50 counterfactual pairs in WorldState-Bench, with 100 clips for individual evaluation and 50 pairs for joint evaluation (§ 4 ).
Each backend generates one clip of a few seconds per action at its native resolution and frame rate.
Clips contain 77 to 128 frames at 15 to 24 fps, with resolutions from 592 × 336 592{\times}336 to 1280 × 720 1280{\times}720 .
The harness generates clips at 864 × 480 864{\times}480 and 24 fps.
We evaluate eleven existing backends without additional training or fine-tuning (Table 1 ).
Four image-to-video generators receive instruction text and the initial frame, namely Wan2.2 ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , LongCat-Video ( LongCat Team et al., 2025 ) , HunyuanVideo 1.5 ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , and MiniMax-H3 ( Chen et al., 2026a ) .
Seven interactive world models receive inputs through their standard action interfaces, namely LingBot-World v2 ( Robbyant Team et al., 2026 ) , Echo-WM Flash ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , FantasyWorld ( Dai et al., 2026 ) , AlayaWorld ( AlayaWorld Team et al., 2026 ) , InSpatio-World ( InSpatio Team et al., 2026 ) , Astra ( Zhu et al., 2026b ) , and HY-WorldPlay ( Sun et al., 2025 ) .
The Qwen3.8-27B-VL judge evaluates frames sampled at 3 fps together with the final frame.
Generation and judging use eight A800 80 GB GPUs.

每个后端按其本土分辨率和帧率生成一个片段,每个动作数秒.

牵引装置生成的夹片为864×480864\Times}480和24 fps.

四台图像到视频发电机收到指令文本和初始帧,即Wan2.2(Wan等人,2025年),Long Cat-Video(LongCat Team等人,2025年),HunyuanVideo 1.5(Wu等人,2025年),MiniMax-H3(Chen等人,2026年a).

blocks.en:
Under Rule-only prompting, MiniMax-H3 achieves 66% EndFollow and 32% PairFollow , while Wan2.2 achieves 65% and 32%, respectively (Table 1 ).
The lower joint accuracy indicates that correct outcomes in individual clips do not imply compliance across both hidden states.
Astra, HY-WorldPlay, and InSpatio-World achieve less than 20% EndFollow despite high CntAbsent scores.
These results indicate that the absence of forbidden content can coincide with failure to generate the required event.
Explicit outcome instructions under the Rule+end probe (Track B) improve EndFollow for several backends but do not establish reliable joint compliance.
The highest unwrapped PairStrict score is 26% for Wan2.2, while MiniMax-H3 reaches only 4% PairStrict and 30% CntAbsent .
The reported harness condition resolves each action before generation and does not use compliance judgments to select among repeated video samples.
blocks.zh:
在只规则提示下,MiniMax-H3实现66%的EndFollow和32%的PairFollow,而Wan2.2则分别实现65%和32%(表1).
联合准确度较低表明,单个片段的正确结果并不意味着两个隐藏州都遵守。
Astra,HY-WorldPlay,以及InSpatio-World尽管CntAbsent得分很高,却仍能达到不到20%的EndCaflow.
这些结果表明,没有禁止的内容可能与未能产生所需的事件同时发生.
规则+端探测器(Track B)下的明确结果指示改进了多个后端的EndFollow,但没有建立可靠的联合遵守.
未包装的PairStrict的最高得分是Wan2.2的26%,而MiniMax-H3只达到4%PairStrict和30%CntAbsent.
所报告的控制条件在生成前就解决了每个动作,没有利用合规判断从重复的视频样本中选择.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Human battles won by Stateful Harness
blocks.zh: 图5 按国家优势分列的人类战役获胜情况

blocks.en:
With the same frozen MiniMax-H3 weights, the harness reaches 92% PairFollow , 90% PairStrict , and 96% TwinContrast (Table 1 ).
In the blind human comparison, Stateful Harness is preferred in 98% of pairwise comparisons against four widely-used unwrapped baselines, with no comparison won by a baseline (Figure 5 , Appendix C ).

在盲目的人类比较中,与4个广泛使用的未包装基线相比,98%的对称比较更偏好国家合理性,而基准没有获得任何比较(图5,附录C)。

blocks.en: A component-chain decomposition on WorldState-Bench attributes the gain to outcome specification (+32 points) and to executed state with compiled references (+28 points), with both increments significant under paired exact McNemar tests over the 50 pairs.

blocks.zh: 5.3 定性结果

blocks.en:
Figure 4 shows counterfactual pairs in which unwrapped baselines include the forbidden outcome or reproduce an ending across both hidden states. Appendix Figures 13 and 14 show more pairs.
The harness generates the distinct outcomes specified by the rules.
Figure 6 illustrates how settled state changes condition subsequent generation, using three real harness episodes read through their HUDs.
The three episodes span 15, 29, and 11 turns respectively, showing that Stateful Harness sustains multi-turn interaction on the same frozen weights.
The episodes are also three genres: town exploration, dating narrative, and turn-based duel, each with its own state transitions and rules.
Each genre is a new executable game definition on the same runtime and video model, instantiated training-free.

剧集还有三个流派: 城镇探索,约会叙事,以及回合制决斗,每集都有自己的州际过渡和规则.

Channel Ablation. Table 8 compares reference channel configurations while holding the video model weights fixed.
First-frame anchoring raises the full split from 74.2 to 76.1 and setting adherence from 71.1 to 89.6, and adding the control video reaches 79.0 on navigation with interaction rising from 69.0 to 77.7, consistent with the preview’s camera guidance. Consistency dips from 83.8 to 75.3 and recovers to 77.8.
Supplying the same control video under the raw text protocol yields 67.1 on the full split, improving camera trajectory scores. This transfer of the preview’s geometry and appearance into the output motivates instructions that specify how the reference should be interpreted.
Thirty generated clips illustrate this effect: clay appearance arises when the instruction does not identify the reference as a layout preview (§ 3.2 ).
On our benchmark, the same frozen weights under the full harness improve every metric in Table 1 over the raw baseline of its track by 30 to 86 points: EndFollow from 66 to 96, PairFollow from 32 to 92, TwinContrast from 32 to 96, and PairStrict from 4 to 90.

30个生成的剪辑说明了这种效果:当指令未将引用确定为布局预览时,粘土出现(§3.2).
根据我们的基准,完全控制下相同的冷冻重量比轨道的原始基线提高表1中的每个度量: 尾随从66到96,尾随从32到92,双联赛从32到96,尾随从4到90.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
Navigation control enables exploration of a generated scene.
Counterfactual pairs test whether the same action produces the distinct outcomes required by different hidden states under shared rules.
On WorldState-Bench, unwrapped image-to-video backends often fail this test even when the ending is specified in the prompt.
The Stateful Harness separates rule execution from video rendering, with explicit semantic and spatial state determining the event depicted by a frozen video model.
Visual observations of the generated clip inform the state used in subsequent interactions.
With MiniMax-H3 weights held fixed, PairFollow increases from 32% under Rule-only instructions and 64% with explicit ending instructions to 92% with the full harness.
These results support explicit state and executable rules for controlling stateful rendered interactions.
The same recipe already sustains multi-turn episodes of 11 to 29 turns and extends to spatial triggers, where the rule program, not the renderer, absorbs the added bookkeeping.
blocks.zh:
导航控制可以对生成的场景进行探索.
反事实对对测试同一个动作是否产生不同隐藏状态在共享规则下所要求的不同结果.
在World State-Bench上,未包装的图像到视频后端往往会失败这个测试,即使结尾在提示中指定.
国有的Harness将规则执行与视频渲染区分开来,有明确的语义和空间状态来决定被冷冻的视频模型描绘的事件.
对生成的剪辑的视觉观测为后续互动中使用的状态提供了信息.
由于MiniMax-H3的重量被固定,Paircap根据只规则指令从32%增加到了64%,明确结束指令从全带增加到了92%.
这些结果支持控制状态互动的明确状态和可执行规则。
同样的食谱已经维持了11至29个转弯的多转弯,并延伸到空间触发器,规则程序而不是渲染器吸收了添加的记账.

blocks.en: AI Usage Statement
blocks.zh: AI 用法声明

blocks.en:
We used generative AI tools for manuscript writing assistance and for auxiliary tooling scripts, but not for research ideation, experiment design, or producing any reported result.
AI models are also used as system components, for judging generated videos and for constructing game definitions.
All AI-assisted output was reviewed by authors, who take full responsibility for the final content.

blocks.en: Appendix A WorldState-Bench: Case Construction Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 世界国家-奔驰:案例构建细节

blocks.en:
Each case comprises five components.
These components are a theme and scene description, a first frame generated by FLUX.2 at 1280 × 720 1280{\times}720 , a hidden variable declaration name ∈ { v A , v B } \texttt{name}\in\{v_{A},v_{B}\} , an action script, and rule text specifying distinct endings.
Twins A/B share the theme, frame, action, and rules.
They differ in the hidden value.
The suite spans 21 themes (magic academy, dungeon, open-world exploration, dating, visual novel, museum, survival, escape room, sailing, farming, ranch, camping, shopkeeping, card games, board games, detective, turn-based combat, stealth, healing, cooking, and fishing) and 49 distinct hidden variables.
blocks.zh:
每个案件由五个部分组成。
这些组件是一个主题和场景描述,由FLUX.2在1280×720 1280\times}720生成的第一个帧,隐藏的可变声明名称 {{{ v A, v B}\textt{name}\in\{v_{A},v_{B}\},动作脚本,规则文本指定不同的结局.
Twins A/B分享主题,框架,动作和规则.
它们在隐藏值上有所不同.
该套套房涵盖21个主题(魔法学院,地牢,开放世界探索,约会,视觉小说,博物馆,生存,逃生室,航海,农耕,牧场,露营,店铺,纸牌游戏,棋盘游戏,侦探,回合制战斗,隐形,愈合,烹饪,和钓鱼)和49个截然不同的隐藏变量.

blocks.en:
The hidden values fall into three response types. Mechanism selection decides which object or mechanism responds (42 cases, e.g., a gate mode that raises the stone door versus a brazier mode that lights tall flames). Character response decides whether a character or creature responds instead of an object (6 cases, e.g., sheep gathering at a trough, an NPC sitting down). Form selection decides which elemental form or scene side carries the effect (2 cases, e.g., red versus blue flames, the left versus the right brazier).
All are invisible in the frame by construction and by audit.
blocks.zh:
隐藏值分为三种响应类型. 机制选择决定对象或机制的响应(42个案例,例如,升起石门的门模式与点燃高火焰的Brazier模式). 字符响应决定一个字符或生物是响应而不是对象(6个案例,如羊在槽中聚集,NPC坐下). 窗体选择决定哪一种元素形式或场景侧面带有效果(2例,如红色对蓝色火焰,左对右刹车).
通过施工和审计,框架都看不见。

blocks.en:
Cases also differ in how the rule trigger is expressed, with cast covering verbal or ritual actions (20 clips), gesture covering physical actions (42), mechanism covering object interactions (26), and zone covering entry into or use of a spatial region (12).
Zone-triggered cases are the most demanding (§ 5.2 ) because compliance additionally requires the render to make the zone’s state visible.
This motivates the spatial channel.
blocks.zh:
案例在规则触发方式的表述上也有所不同,铸币覆盖口头或仪式行动(20个片段),手势覆盖物理行动(42个),机制覆盖物体相互作用(26个),区域覆盖进入或使用空间区域(12个)。
区划案是最苛刻的(第5.2节),因为遵守要求还要使区划的状态明显可见。
这激发了空间通道的动力.

blocks.en:
Every case is evaluated under two probes compiled from the same card. Rule-only provides the original “Inputs to the video model” text from the case specification, including the scene, shared action script, rule with both branches, and the consequence of the selected branch. Rule+end appends the required terminal state using the visual vocabulary defined for the case and explicitly asks the model to maintain this final state.
The difference between the two conditions measures the effect of adding an explicit terminal outcome instruction.
Table 5 reports this difference for each backend.
blocks.zh:
每个案件都通过从同一张卡中编译的两个探测器进行评估. 仅规则提供了案件规格的原始"输入视频模型"文本,包括场景,共享动作脚本,与两个分支的规则,以及选定分支的后果. 规则+end 附加所需的终端状态,使用为案件定义的视觉词汇,并明确要求模型保持这个最终状态.
这两个条件之间的差异衡量了增加明确的终端结果指示的效果。
表5报告了每个后端的这一差异。

blocks.en:
Each first frame undergoes eight rounds of VLM auditing across six dimensions to check for visible evidence of the hidden value.
The dimensions are object presence, color attribution, text, spatial cues, count cues, and state cues.
If the audit detects evidence of the hidden value, the frame is regenerated using a revised prompt.
The audit prompts, model settings, and the regeneration log are part of the reproduction artifacts listed in Appendix H .
blocks.zh:
每个第一帧经过8轮VLM审计,共6个维度,以检查隐藏值的可见证据.
维度是对象存在,颜色归属,文字,空间提示,计数提示,以及状态提示.
如果审计发现隐藏值的证据,则使用修改后的提示重新生成帧.
审计提示、模型设置和再生记录是附录H所列复制文物的一部分。

blocks.en:
Rules are written in plain English with fixed sentence frames per family, e.g. “If the flame is RED, the ward shatters and the door opens.
If the flame is BLUE, the ward holds and the door stays sealed.”
Both rule branches specify their endings so that the DSL can derive expected outcomes directly.
blocks.zh:
规则用纯英语写成,每个家庭都有固定的句子框,例如. “如果火焰是红外线的,病房就会破碎,门就会打开。
如果火焰是BLUE,则病房会坚守,门会密封. “
两个规则分支都指定了它们的结局,这样DSL就可以直接得出预期的结果.

blocks.en:
Figures 7 and 8 present complete examples for the orb pair under Rule-only instructions and the sign pair under Rule+end instructions, respectively.
Each example includes the audited first frame, case specification, two baseline prompts, compiled VisualScript instruction, and the rule program with its settled state.

blocks.en: Appendix B Judging Protocol and Metric Definitions
blocks.zh: 附录B 判断议定书和计量定义

blocks.en:
For each clip the judge answers two scored questions with fixed choices: (Q1) which ending occurs at the end of the clip, with mandated, forbidden, and unclear as the choices.
(Q2) asks whether the forbidden outcome appears anywhere in the clip, with yes and no as the choices.
The case program specifies both outcomes.
Initial-state and action-onset questions are also recorded but excluded from the primary metrics.
Answers outside the choice set or missing answers score as incorrect.
Fixed answer choices constrain the output format and make verdicts reproducible. The accuracy of the judge’s visual interpretation is audited against blinded human raters in Appendix C .

blocks.en:
The judge receives sampled frames, the shared scene description, the action, and the branch-specific expected outcomes.
The hidden value, rule program, and expected outcome of the other instance are excluded from the judge inputs.
Reproducing a verdict requires the same clips, sampled frames, questions, judge version, and inference settings.
The case program fixes the expected outcomes before video generation.

The reported metrics are therefore produced by a fixed, versioned judge protocol and are validated against blinded human ratings on the audited subset.

blocks.en: Appendix C Human Audit Platform and Protocols
blocks.zh: 附录C 人道审计平台和协议

blocks.en:
We assess agreement between the VLM judge and human raters through audits conducted on a web platform (Appendix B ).
Each auditor receives a numeric identifier and a fixed assignment of evaluation items.
The interface displays rendered clips and rule text while concealing system identities, prompts, and instruction conditions.
The positions of systems in pairwise comparisons are randomized.
The platform operates in two modes, mirroring the two question types of the benchmark.

Seventeen cases, comprising nine Rule-only cases and eight Rule+end cases, are evaluated for both hidden states using the full harness, the frozen MiniMax-H3 baseline, and Wan2.2.
This produces 102 clips for verification.
For each clip, auditors answer the same two fixed choice questions used by the VLM judge.
Q1 assesses whether the required ending occurs, and Q2 assesses whether the forbidden outcome appears anywhere in the clip.
Both questions include an explicit “unclear” option in the human interface.
Each clip receives three independent blinded ratings.
Figure 9 shows the clip-verification interface.

blocks.en:
The three instruction conditions form a component chain on WorldState-Bench.
Rule-only prompting leaves 32% of pairs jointly correct (Table 1 , Track A). Supplying the required ending—a component that the harness’s compiled instruction always includes—raises this to 64% (Table 4 ). The full harness, which adds deterministic compilation, rule settlement, and the anchored reference channels, reaches 92% with the same frozen weights (§ 5.2 ).
The increments attribute the gain to outcome specification (+32 points) and to executed state with compiled references (+28 points). Both are significant under the paired exact McNemar test described above ( p = 4.0 × 10 − 4 p=4.0\times 10^{-4} and p = 2.6 × 10 − 3 p=2.6\times 10^{-3} ), with paired bootstrap 95% CIs of [ 16 , 48 ] [16,48] and [ 12 , 44 ] [12,44] points.
The external channel ablation mirrors the endpoints without our case grammar (Table 8 : 74.2 raw text vs. 77.9 full harness overall).

增量将收益归结为结果规格(+32分),并用编译的参考文献(+28分)执行状态. 两者在上述配对精确的McNemar试验(p = 4.0× 10 − 4 p = 4.0\times 10^{-4}和p = 2.6× 10 − 3 p = 2.6\time 10^{-3})下都是重要的,配对的靴子圈95%的CI为[16,48][16,48]和[12,44][12,44]分.

blocks.en:
Explicit outcome instructions yield the largest improvements when correct outcome selection and exclusion of forbidden content improve together.
Wan2.2 A14B gains + 9 +9 with EndFollow + 7 +7 , CntAbsent + 9 +9 , and a TwinContrast gain of + 16 +16 .
Astra gains + 5 +5 points, primarily through reduced direction errors from a low initial score of 11%, while its copy-paste rate remains at 70%.
LongCat-Video ( + 7 +7 ) and LingBot-World ( + 5 +5 ) combine reduced direction errors with stable or lower leakage.
FantasyWorld gains + 3 +3 points through improved exclusion of forbidden content, with CntAbsent increasing from 75 to 81.
For HunyuanVideo 1.5, improved ending accuracy is accompanied by increased leakage from 25 to 34, the highest value among the external backends, resulting in a negative Δ \Delta Strict .
The four backends with negative Δ \Delta Strict , HunyuanVideo 1.5, AlayaWorld, InSpatio-World, and HY-WorldPlay, have copy-paste rates ranging from 36% to 82%.
These results indicate that explicit ending instructions do not reliably produce distinct outcomes across hidden states or exclude contradictory content.
The mean Δ \Delta Strict over the other ten backends is + 2.3 +2.3 points (six rise, four fall), consistent with § 5.2 .
Figure 11 reports the eleven differences, with the dashed line indicating the mean across the ten backends excluding MiniMax-H3.

LongCat-Video(+7+7)和LingBot-World(+5+5)结合了已减少的方向误差和稳定或较低的渗漏.
最终幻想世界增益+3+3分通过改进禁内容的排除,CntAbsent从75增加到81.
对HunyuanVideo 1.5来说,改进的结局精度伴随着从25到34的渗漏增加,是外部后端中最高值,导致负QQ\Delta严格.

blocks.en:
The diagnostics identify three recurring failure patterns. Copy-paste. Under Rule+end, identical verdicts occur for both instances in 82% of HY-WorldPlay pairs, 72% of InSpatio-World pairs, and 70% of Astra pairs.
Their TwinContrast scores range from 10% to 22%, indicating limited differentiation between the paired outcomes. Direction Failure. Astra and HY-WorldPlay have direction error rates of 89% and 91% under Rule-only instructions, despite CntAbsent scores of 96% and 95%.
The generated clips often exhibit limited state change, so the absence of forbidden content alone does not establish compliance. Leakage. HunyuanVideo 1.5 depicts forbidden content together with the required ending in 25% of clips under Rule-only instructions.
This increases to 34% under Rule+end, the highest rate among the external backends.
The harness reduces all three error types (Table 6 ).

他们的双联赛得分从10%到22%不等,表明对联结果的区别有限. 方向失败。 Astra和HY-WorldPlay的定向误差率只有规则指令下的89%和91%,尽管CntAbsent的得分是96%和95%.
生成的剪辑往往表现出有限的状态变化,因此单凭禁内容的缺失并不能确定遵守. 泄泻. HunyuanVideo 1.5根据"规则"指令在25%的剪辑中描绘了禁内容和要求的结局.
这在"规则+端"下增加到34%,是外部后端中最高的.

blocks.en:
Table 6 reports the twin-mechanism diagnostics where both twins are generated under identical conditions (MiniMax-H3 single-clip runs), for both spatial-reference settings.
With the deployed first-frame reference, the harness reduces copy-paste from 30% to 2% and increases TwinContrast from 46% to 96%.
The text-only configuration has no copy-paste errors but higher direction error (6% versus 4%) and leakage (5% versus 1%), with the same TwinContrast and branch gap.

blocks.en:
The navigation split exhibits the same overall pattern as the full split, with larger differences between configurations.
First-frame anchoring increases setting adherence from 72.7 to 91.5 and the overall navigation score to 76.8.
It also reduces consistency from 85.0 to 75.0, with little change in camera trajectory (68.9 to 69.0).
Adding the control video increases camera trajectory from 69.0 to 77.7 and the overall navigation score to 79.0.
Consistency improves by 4.2 points, from 75.0 to 79.2.
Video quality increases across the three configurations from 77.5 to 79.5 to 80.1, while physical plausibility remains within 0.6 points of the raw text configuration.
The raw text protocol with the control video obtains the highest camera trajectory score of 79.3 but an overall navigation score of 65.7.
Its setting adherence (53.0), consistency (64.8), and physical plausibility (58.0) are all below the raw text configuration without the preview.
These results are consistent with the observed reproduction of preview geometry when the instructions do not specify how the spatial reference should be interpreted.

一致性提高了4.2个百分点,从75.0提高到79.2。
视频质量在三种配置中从77.5升至79.5升至80.1,而物理可信度保持在原始文本配置的0.6点以内.
带有控制视频的原始文本协议获得最高的相机轨迹得分79.3,但总体导航得分65.7.
其设置的坚持性(53.0),一致性(64.8),以及物理的可信性(58.0)都低于没有预览的原始文本配置.
这些结果与所观察到的预览几何复制一致,当指令没有规定空间参考应当如何解释时.

Figure 15 unrolls the first real episode (Case A of Figure 6 ) act by act: all fifteen acts plus the ending card, two frames per act at native aspect, each header carrying the Traveler HUD state read at the act’s first frame.

Figure 17 unrolls the third real episode (Case C of Figure 6 ) turn by turn: all eleven turns of the boss duel plus the victory screen, two frames per turn at native aspect, each header carrying the in-video HUD state read at the turn’s first frame.
The three attack skills cycle — Forbidden Scripture: Falling Red Sun (heavy fire), Paradox: Zero-Degree Stigma (ice, shield-shattering), Oracle: First Sentence (costless arcane) — the defensive Gate of the End is played at turn 8, and the final Falling Red Sun takes the arbiter from 6 to 0 between turns 10 and 11.

blocks.en:
World initialization is performed once per episode.
The per-domain program instantiates the game through registry build \mathrm{build} .
The backend and kernel services are checked for availability before interaction begins.
The initial frame is chosen from the declared frame, a user-supplied image, or a placeholder in that order.
Each turn then runs nine steps.
(1) The gate check ends the episode on terminal status, a reached turn budget, or an empty action space.
(2) The player selects an action through choose ⁡ ( state , actions ) \mathrm{choose}(\mathrm{state},\mathrm{actions}) .
Scripted, random, human-CLI, and LLM-proposed players use the same rule layer.
In the deployed instances the proposal kernel and the LLM-proposed player are one resident Qwen3.8-27B-VL service ( Yang and others, 2025 ) .
(3) The rule program τ R \tau_{R} evaluates the action on a copy of the state without modifying its input.
This records the outcome before video generation.
(4) A per-domain director maps the result and visual state into a VisualScript script.
(5) The compiler validates the script and rejects invalid input before generation.
(6) Invalid rendering requests produce an error.
Transient errors trigger bounded retries, followed by the failure policy.
The default policy reuses the previous anchor and counts the turn as played.
(7) The final frame, extracted with ffmpeg -sseof , becomes the next visual anchor.
(8) The VLM interprets the generated clip and proposes changes to observable state fields.
The runtime validates these proposals against the fixed rules and incorporates accepted updates into the state for the next turn.
(9) A JSON record stores the state before and after the turn, events, IR, compiled prompt, seed, latency, and render errors.
Reproducing the observation feedback additionally requires recording the visual observations and accepted state updates.
After the final turn, an ending director may render a presentation clip and a montage assembler may join the episode with state captions.
Neither operation changes the terminal state fixed by the rules.
Table 10 summarizes the input and output of each operation.

blocks.en:
One forward pass of a feed-forward geometry model ( Wang et al., 2025 ) produces depth, world points, and part features from the current frame.
Clustering yields per-instance oriented boxes.
Scale is anchored by the 1.7 m human prior and recovered camera height.
The boxes instantiate an untextured Blender ( Blender Online Community, 2025 ) scene with the CV-to-Blender coordinate correction, and procedural camera programs (push-in, orbit, head-push) render the preview clip when a turn needs camera or layout motion.
The scene file records boxes and camera explicitly and supports edits by rules or humans.
The deployed spatial channel in § 3.2 uses the single-subject configuration of this pipeline.
WildDet3D, a 1.2B-parameter detector built on SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2025 ) and LingBot-Depth, localizes the subject in the anchor frame.
An oriented box is positioned by pinhole anchoring under the real-height prior.
A ground plane is fitted to a depth region adjacent to the subject and checked against the pinhole ray.
Blender renders a single clay preview under the original camera, aligned pixel-wise with the input view.
The synthesizer is deterministic given its inputs and never writes to the ledger.
When the instruction does not identify the reference as a layout preview, the backend can reproduce the clay materials instead of using the preview solely as spatial guidance. The instruction therefore identifies it as a layout preview.

Adding a case therefore requires specifying a program from which these outcomes can be reproduced.
(ii) Twin Symmetry. A linter checks that the rule branches are mutually exclusive and that the paired inputs differ only in the hidden value and its consequences.
(iii) Hidden State Isolation. The frame_prompt must not reveal the hidden value.
The audit of Appendix A enforces this on the rendered frame itself.

blocks.en:
In detail, its style and first-frame anchor slots describe the desired appearance and restate the anchor image.
The camera slot uses a fixed vocabulary for motion, while the clay model provides the 3D trajectory.
The actor and appearance slots carry textual identity across scenes.
The action , target , reaction , dialogue , and effects slots describe the event.
Dialogue includes speaker ids and constraints for off-screen speech.
The stability slot constrains identity, clothing, and position.
The end state specifies what the next anchor should show.
The record also includes soundscape , music , and shots with validated sentence budgets and cut times.
A use-first-frame flag may break the anchor chain on scene changes, leaving appearance slots to carry identity (§ 3.2 ).
The record states who acts and how the turn ends within the roughly 5 s clip budget.
Validation rejects illegal records before compilation, and the backend adapter owns the prompt dialect.

blocks.en:
Compilation either produces an instruction or rejects the record before generation.
Identical valid records produce identical instructions under the same adapter.
(i) Schema Validation. The action, actor, and end-state fields must be nonempty.
Free text descriptions cannot contain shot markers, and multiple shots must be declared in the shots field.
(ii) Budget Validation. The compiler checks sentence limits for each field and the uniqueness of speaker tags.
A violation raises an error before rendering.
(iii) Assembly. The compiler orders style, first-frame anchoring, camera motion, actor action, reaction, dialogue, effects, declared shots, stability constraints, and the required end state.
It assigns shot timestamps while reserving a final interval for the ending.
The stability constraints and final state are expressed through fixed sentence templates.
(iv) Adapter Fields. The adapter appends the protocol fields required by the backend, including the first-frame alignment instruction in image-conditioned mode or its replacement in text-only mode.
Separating the instruction format from the game definition allows the same game code to support backends with different input grammars.

blocks.en:
The VisualScript compiler is a deterministic function of the script and backend adapter, with no sampling, model calls, or formatting that depends on the environment.
Given the same inputs, it produces the same instruction string, allowing compilation and backend adaptation to be checked independently of video generation (§ 3.2 ).
blocks.zh:
VisualScript编译器是脚本和后端适配器的定型功能,没有采样,模型调用,或格式化取决于环境.
基于相同的输入,它会生成相同的指令字符串,使得编译和后端的修改可以独立于视频生成进行检查(§3.2).

blocks.en: Appendix H Reproducibility Details
blocks.zh: 附录H 可复制性 细节

blocks.en:
Independent reproduction requires the 50 case programs, first-frame prompts and images, audit records, rule programs, VisualScript grammar and compiler, backend adapters and generation settings, sampled clips, fixed choice judge prompts, and per-clip verdicts.
The case programs determine the expected outcomes and the compiler is deterministic, so each reported number is traceable from a case program through compilation to its per-clip verdicts.
blocks.zh:
独立复制需要50个案例程序,第一帧提示和图像,审计记录,规则程序,VisualScript语法和编译器,后端适配器和生成设置,样本片段,固定选择裁判提示,以及每个clip判断.
案件程序确定预期结果,编译器具有决定性,因此每个报告的数字可以通过汇编到每个clip判决中从一个案件程序追踪到.

blocks.en:
Rule settlement and compilation are deterministic for fixed programs, input states, actions, and accepted neural proposals.
The optional proposal kernel, video backend, and visual observer may produce different outputs across runs.
The final frame of each clip conditions subsequent generation, and accepted visual observations affect the next world state.
Reproducing an episode therefore also requires the same observation stream and accepted state updates.
A reproducibility package should record backend and observer versions, inference settings, reference clips, sampled frames, observations, and accepted updates.
blocks.zh:
规则的解析和汇编对于固定程序,输入状态,行动,以及被接受的神经元建议都是决定性的.
可选的建议书内核,视频后端,以及视觉观察者可能会产生不同的跨运行输出.
每个剪辑条件的最终框架后续生成,以及接受的视觉观测会影响下一个世界状态.
因此,转载一集还需要同样的观察流和接受状态更新.
可复制包应记录后端和观察者版本、推论设置、参考片段、抽样框架、观察和接受的更新。

blocks.en:
MiniMax-H3 is used with text instruction and image anchor, and the deployed instruction dialect follows the official H3 prompt-writing guide distributed with the model.
The full harness additionally supplies a preview clip through its video-reference input.
Unwrapped interactive backends are driven through their available action interfaces.
No backend weights are modified for the reported comparison.
The adapter isolates the backend-specific instruction dialect, so extending to further backends is instruction-level work.

使用MiniMax-H3时使用文字指令和图像锚定,部署的指令方言遵循了随模型分发的官方H3即时写作指南.
全面利用还通过其视频参考输入提供了预览片段。
未包装的互动后端通过它们现有的动作界面驱动.
对于报告的比较,没有修改后端加权.
适配器将后端特定指令方言隔离,因此延伸至进一步的后端是指令级工作.

blocks.en: Appendix I Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录一 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
The box-based clay model provides a coarse representation of spatial layout.
Errors in instance recovery propagate to the preview, and the text instruction does not always prevent the renderer from reproducing the clay appearance.
Articulated pose and fine appearance are determined by the video model, and the spatial pipeline operates offline.
blocks.zh:
盒式粘土模型为空间布局提供了粗糙的体现.
实例恢复中的错误传播到预览中,文本指令并不总是阻止渲染器复制粘土外观.
外形和精细外观由视频模型决定,空间管道运行于离线.

blocks.en:
Future work targets a more capable harness: a richer rule language with temporal and quantified conditions, state that tracks more entities and relations, and compiled instructions that carry the same frozen weights to further video backends.
Beyond the current case families, we plan to scale the closed loop to more diverse world scenarios and settings, including longer episodes, multi-agent interactions, and open-ended environments where goals and rules evolve over time.
blocks.zh:
未来的工作目标是一种更有能力的利用:一种具有时间和量化条件的更丰富的规则语言,说明追踪更多的实体和关系,并汇编了带有同样冷冻重量的指令以进一步增加视频后端.
除了目前的案例外,我们计划把封闭循环扩大到更多样化的世界情景和背景,包括更长的事件、多代理互动以及目标和规则随时间演变的无限制环境。
